name: Nord
description: Sven Greb's arctic palette: Nord, and a light mode built from Snow Storm grounds and Polar Night text.

sources.author: Sven Greb
sources.note: Nord documents bright-ambiance use: nord6 as background and area colour, Polar Night for plain text. The light mode here is an extension built on that rule.

bg.source: extension: nord6 as background (Nord bright ambiance)

fg.source: extension: nord0 (Polar Night plain text in bright ambiance)

accent.source: extension: nord10 (the darkest Frost, for action colour on light grounds)

accent-hover.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.06 away from on-accent

accent-press.derived: accent with OKLab lightness moved 0.12 away from on-accent

scrim.derived: the darker of light.fg and dark.bg

success-text.derived: success (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

warning-text.derived: warning (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

danger-text.derived: danger (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

info-text.derived: info (contrast solving adjusts it on each ground)

chart-6.derived: red (cyan and the hues after it sit within 0.065 OKLab of the text colour or 0.08 of an earlier chart colour)
